finding: With no key, no account, no wallet and no payment, a GET of https://agi.apify.com/protocols/x402/prepaid-tokens?amount=1&currency=usd, the vendor's own example for buying a prepaid Apify API token, answered HTTP/2 402 on 2026-10-19 at 12:17:15Z with a 2,879-byte x402 version 2 body and a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header offering three ways to pay the $1 asked for, scheme exact at 1000000 units each: USDC on Base, USDC on Solana, and a second Solana asset the vendor's page calls USDT. The vendor documents the door in its own words: agents 'can run Apify Actors and pay with stablecoins on Base or Solana. No Apify account needed.' What is sold is a spend-capped token, not a result, so what an agent can do after paying is the API's and the MCP server's authenticated surface, which is not measured here. One IP is one sample.
